notes.title: When will the next major update release?
notes.notes:
[b]why bother making this announcement? [/b]
TLDR: A campaign and new editing tools are being worked on. It might take a while to release though. Dont expect anything other than important bug fixes here and there until then.


[h3]New Upcoming Tools.[/h3]
Since the campaign will be built using the in-game map creator, new unique tools are being added to make narrative/story elements possible. 

Its hard to decide what to add and how simple to make it. If the level editing tools become too complicated, people are better off spending their time in an actual game engine. Anything being added will be more limited than what other engines can do, but [u]the important part is how simple and quickly it will be to create stuff without needing to look something up on a wiki [/u]or whatever.

It wont be anything crazy like visual scripting. Just enough to create some decent variety/scenarios within maps.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42603853/ad27c627fbd73950fe5ba990402d13c1d8dad3b7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42603853/3fc20a82084b839d0bf0832ebd385c4c93b46151.gif[/img]

[h3]The good news.[/h3]
when this update releases, the game will be considered a "complete" game by consumer standards (thanks to the campaign). There is still a lot of room for improvement in the level editor afterwards (the game will remain in early access).

[h3]The bad news.[/h3]
Its gonna take a while. Best time estimate i can give is "before christmas".


[h3]Upcoming Discount: [/h3]
game will be on sale again during the next seasonal sale

[under construction]

notes.title: Level Editing Update Part 1 of ?
notes.notes:
This update is small in size, but it brings major changes to map creation possibilities.

First of all. Thank you for your patience. This is the first major update of many for the game. It was slow to develop because it was very technical for me.

This "game" was made to create simple abstract worlds with. The major focus is on the "gallery" building and media sharing. But i saw people having difficulty simply creating a "normal room".  Because of this, i worked on adding some tools to make things easier.

[b]The game is still meant for building abstract worlds, but these new tools should make some things a lot easier to build[/b]


[h1]Painter Tool Changes:[/h1]

[h3]Player can now create custom textures using media[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42603853/df421c88f645b98c5782b00247d05e0e6584519e.png[/img]
You can use images, gifs, and videos(videos will be muted).

[h3]Players can now re-color and paint the individual faces of a block[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42603853/7e9f2dd9246ef223e7ae25639fae9a445ac8236d.png[/img]

[h3]The painter tool now copy and pastes the UV properties of a face[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42603853/5e698eec8e3ed64f935251d84c7a8ae8b26c6cf4.png[/img]

[h3]Added the ability to change the transparency of the color[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42603853/cd37a059e194bc2343d03c23f8ebf9c6a67a7f35.png[/img]
Make sure to use a transparent shader!


[h1]Added Transform Tool[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42603853/814b3cca0ff16c629e52c7b315bfcc3a65909fb3.png[/img]
Lets you select multiple blocks, resize [b]individual [/b]blocks, rotate, and duplicate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42603853/ef4779d7125e752a8cfe4d1b06a9ac81f10d0391.png[/img]
You can snap to corners by holding X.

[h1]Added Corner Editing Tool[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42603853/db36ba721091803807c267312fefc9c0e3473025.png[/img]
This will break some things such as movement, object placement, and cause texture warping. But its there if you want it.

[h1]Added UV Face editing Tools[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42603853/9c13412e181debb2997d14af1139de67105e828c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42603853/c9d3d12fb39935a23293c7a6522703605b230620.png[/img]

[h3]UV Offset: Change the offset of a texture[/h3]
[h3]UV Scale: Change the scale of a texture[/h3]
[h3]UV Rotation: Change the rotation of a texture[/h3]

[h1]Added tool descriptions and tips on the wheel menu[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42603853/3134fda6d145643201beabd3c8c08185812bc49c.png[/img]

[h1]Added  "creative mode" [/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42603853/203242935ea2e0f78895c2cea09a563f0ef2b138.png[/img]
press v when inside one of your maps (will not work while exploring a workshop or online url map)


[h1]Smaller Changes[/h1]

* Changed the ambience in the hub.

* Images under 64x64 resolution will now have texture filtering disabled(for pixel art)

* Added hub button confirmation window 

* Block destroyer tool now has infinite range

* Removed the notification warnings about empty canvases that on level start (some players thought the map was broke when in reality the map had empty canvas templates for them to use).

[h1]Problems im aware of[/h1]
* Currently, using texture UV tools may not align them accurately. pressing up or down on the scroll wheel will either make an offset too far, or too close. It would have been easy to simply add an input field that lets you change the decimals accurately, however, these types of precision mechanics are not in the "abstract" spirit of the game.

* Duplicating posters will load the media as if it is unique! (this will be fixed in a future update).


[h1]Whats next?[/h1]
"Level Editing Update Part 1 of ?" 
Since this is a gallery exploration sandbox, it leaves room open for many possibilities such as real time lighting and model importing. However none of this is confirmed. There are bigger issues to resolve at the moment. Such as: 

1. I noticed while playing, a lot of players dont link to online urls OR the url goes down, causing the media not to load at all. The next update will likely focus on image packing images from your computer onto the map.

2. The game still dosnt have a real campaign, theres no incentive for players to explore maps. Next major update will likely be related to a new gamemode/campaign. (similar to the prologue)

notes.title: Early Access Day 1 Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Important[/h1]
[b](REMOVED) Material Painter [/b]- Most of the materials were removed and only a couple remain. In the future, players will be able to use their own media to create their own materials. The Steam page screenshots were replaced by new ones to reflect this.


[h1]UPDATE[/h1]

[b]Workshop Support[/b]
Most of the workshop features were made to let players quickly upload/update their maps.

[b]Upload Window [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42603853/b469899a259a7fd891c61b70a26405b5ec74de42.png[/img]
Just pick the json file and submit it. (thumbnail image and name is recommended but not required)

[b]Update Window[/b]
Similar to the previous window, except pick which map you want to update beforehand.

[b]Skybox Media[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42603853/7dba15dbccb456c0ae1c7001b133b048134e8cb1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42603853/85028b12387bcf770fc3d25d95c4a6cdb88c632c.png[/img]
Upload an image or video. Change the scale and/or make it scroll.

[b]Random Workshop Map [Robot Option][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42603853/4680b41c287b382ced7a6211244d9d2a543f0686.png[/img]
Randomly picks a map from the workshop for you to explore. Keep in mind the search algorithm may break as the workshop content increases. This will be the first thing to be fixed as soon as it breaks.

[b]Missions  [Robot Option][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42603853/e739b5784cf54d6c6554013ffc3d7f0b239875b2.png[/img]
If you cant come up with anything, try starting a mission. Create a map and turn it into the workshop to submit a mission.


[b]Chaser Bot [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42603853/5073d6ee135c7e6b04a2693d66ba1b708d4cdc8d.png[/img]
If a user attempts to "cheat" a map from the workshop or somewhere else online, a bot(or an image or video of your choice) will chase the player. (leave the field empty to let players modify freely).

[b]Achievements[/b]
Added 10 achievements that are meant to be reachable by the average player (as of this post there is only one workshop item).

[b]Other minor changes[/b]
-Added Blink noises.
-Changed UI colors and theme.
-When the menu is opened, any media audio will now get muffled.
-Added color picker sounds
-Added a map intro UI animation on the bottom right corner. (shows the name of the map and music track if available)

-Other smaller things i forgot about.

notes.title: Release Day Tommorow (Some info)
notes.notes:
[h1]Early Access Release Day Content[/h1]
Keep in mind there will be new stuff added, but it wont be a huge full "release". Big updates like tomorrow's are planned to continue throughout early access (approximately every 1-4 months depending on the complexity of the roadmap objectives tackled).

[h1]Pricing[/h1]
Since there's still a long roadmap ahead and the workshop is nearly empty as of now. The game will start with a base price of 5.99 and go on sale frequently(35% off) including tomorrow's release day. This game will forever be a one time purchase and there wont be any add-on/DLCs or anything like that.
